evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo 18 documents:: tests incl. 7 documents::import, full lib and integration tests, bun, node, typecheck, gallery 150 passed); three review subagents, final one clean

notes:
Did: documents/import.rs with import_file(pool, app_data_dir, source, now) and pick_source(app), which wraps the Rust dialog (tauri-plugin-dialog, filter md/markdown/txt, blocking: call it from spawn_blocking, as audio/import.rs does). Extension is checked case-insensitively before any read or write; anything else fails with UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT. The bytes are written to <app_data>/documents/<document_id>/<sha256>.<ext> before UTF-8 decoding and extraction. version.sha256 and byte_size cover the raw file bytes, so they match the managed copy; char_count and locator offsets are char offsets into the normalised text (BOM stripped, CRLF to LF), as in D2. managed_path is stored relative to app data ('documents/<id>/<sha>.<ext>'). Title is the file stem. Markdown gets {kind:'section', heading_path, paragraph, start, end}, where paragraph is the index within its section and heading_path is [] before the first heading. Text gets the D2 paragraph locators. parser_version is 'import-markdown-1' or 'import-text-1'. Non-UTF-8 fails with DOCUMENT_NOT_UTF8 and no paragraph fails with DOCUMENT_TEXT_EMPTY; any failure after the copy rolls back the transaction and removes the managed folder. ingest.rs now exposes normalise, paragraph_passages, passage and sha256_hex as pub(super) for reuse. Fixture: tests/fixtures/documents/two-headings.md. No new dependencies.
Assumptions: Markdown is parsed for ATX headings only (up to 3 spaces of indent, 1-6 #, optional closing #s). Setext headings (=== or --- underlines) stay paragraph text. Fenced code (``` or ~~~, at least 3, closed by a bare run at least as long) is never split and never yields headings. A bare '#' heading adds an empty title to heading_path. Each import creates a new document; there is no dedupe across imports.
Learned: pick_source has no caller yet. D5's documents_import should call it inside spawn_blocking and map the raw io error from reading the source (and a FilePath that does not convert, which pick_source currently treats as cancelled) to a SCREAMING_SNAKE code. D4 must add the metadata size check in import_file before tokio::fs::read. The gallery screen peek-inline-transcript light failed once more under load and passed on the rerun.
